page.notes: The italic phrase "In omni afflictione]" opens the second paragraph; it is set in the text block, not in the margin, so I kept it as running text with the printed bracket. The Greek word συμπάθεια is transcribed from the scan and may need checking for accents. Printed spellings such as "charitaté" and "profectò" are kept as printed. No catchword is visible because the last line is a full line.
